title: TikTok Profile Scraper
description: Scrape videos from one or more public TikTok profiles.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: TikTok profile URLs or usernames, e.g. https://www.tiktok.com/@hyundaiuk, @hyundaiuk or hyundaiuk.

resultsPerPage.title: Videos per profile
resultsPerPage.description: Maximum number of latest videos to return for each profile.

oldestPostDate.title: Oldest post date
oldestPostDate.description: Only return videos posted on or after this date. Absolute (2026-09-18) or relative (7 days, 2 weeks, 3 months). Pinned videos never stop the scrape.

excludePinnedPosts.title: Exclude pinned posts
excludePinnedPosts.description: Skip videos pinned to the top of the profile.

proxy.title: Proxy configuration
proxy.description: Proxy used to access TikTok. Apify Proxy is recommended. Switch to the RESIDENTIAL group if you see captcha or block errors.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of profiles processed in parallel. Each one runs a browser tab.

maxRequestRetries.title: Retries
maxRequestRetries.description: How many times a blocked or failed profile is retried with a new browser session and proxy IP.
